narratives.title: Geopolitical Escalation Risk-Off
narratives.summary: Capital is fleeing risk assets as multiple fronts of kinetic conflict (US-Iran, Israel-Hezbollah, Ukraine-Russia) escalate simultaneously, with the Strait of Hormuz blockade persisting and diplomatic off-ramps appearing fragile. The market is underpricing the duration and breadth of these conflicts, driving flows into safe havens and commodities.
narratives.trade_implication: Long WTI crude oil and gold; short S&P 500 and BTC; overweight US Treasuries and USD.

narratives.title: Energy Supply Disruption Pricing
narratives.summary: Capital is rotating into energy assets as the Hormuz blockade structurally tightens supply, with EIA forecasts rising and Kuwait seeking bypass pipelines. The SPR release is being misread as bearish but actually signals government concern over sustained disruption, supporting oil prices.
narratives.trade_implication: Long WTI and Brent futures; long energy equities (XLE); short refined product spreads on supply risk.

narratives.title: Diplomatic Mirage vs. Reality
narratives.summary: Capital is skeptical of White House claims of Iran deal progress, as military actions (Apache shootdown, IDF readiness) contradict diplomatic signals. This narrative drives volatility in risk assets and commodities, with markets pricing a fragile status quo that could break either way.
narratives.trade_implication: Long VIX futures; short USD/IRR; long option straddles on WTI and SPY.
